verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, so the reading order is reversed, and it is spaced so wide that it competes with the headline. The circle has come loose from the phone and floats behind the text on the left. The 'Find It Near You' CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the badges, so it is no longer prominent. B has the same problems and worse ones: the headline is jammed against the left edge and sits on the circle, the subhead is nearly as big as the headline, and the CTA is a tiny pill at the bottom with barely readable text, smaller than in A, so the action is buried.
